hooks.command: grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+add[[:space:]]+(-A|--all|\./?)([[:space:]\"]|$)|git[[:space:]]+commit[[:space:]]+(-a|--all|-am)\b' && { echo 'BLOCK: batch staging is disabled. Stage and commit one file at a time: git add <file> && git commit -m "<msg>"' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0

bash -c 'IN=$(cat); echo "$IN" | grep -qE "\"command\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\"git[[:space:]]" && exit 0; if echo "$IN" | grep -qE "(npm run dev|npm run server|npm start|npm run start|npx vite|vite dev|vite preview|node server/index.js|tail -f|--watch)" && ! echo "$IN" | grep -qE "\"run_in_background\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*true"; then echo "BLOCK: long-running command without backgrounding. Launch it with run_in_background: true, then poll its output with bounded checks." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'IN=$(cat); N=$(echo "$IN" | grep -o "&&" | wc -l); if [ "$N" -ge 3 ]; then echo "BLOCK: command chain too long. One hung link freezes the whole turn: split into separate calls of two or three related commands." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0'

grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+reset[[:space:]][^|;&]*--hard|git[[:space:]]+clean[[:space:]]+-[A-Za-z]*f|git[[:space:]]+branch[[:space:]][^|;&]*-D([[:space:]"\\]|$)|git[[:space:]]+(checkout|restore)[[:space:]]+(--[[:space:]]+)?\.([[:space:]"\\]|$)|git[[:space:]]+push[^|;&]*[[:space:]](-f|--force|--force-with-lease|--force-if-includes)([[:space:]="\\]|$)|git[[:space:]]+push[^|;&]*[[:space:]]\+[^[:space:]"\\]+' && { echo 'BLOCK: destructive git command. Hard resets, git clean, force-deleting a branch, unscoped checkout or restore, and force pushes destroy work that exists on one laptop only (data/ holds the saved memories) or rewrite history teammates already pulled: leave them to a person.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0
